rulers.name: Ben-hadad
rulers.title: King of Syria (Aram), who dwelt at Damascus
rulers.tagline: Paid by Asa to break his league with Baasha.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length of reign for any Ben-hadad.
prophets: One of the sons of the prophets
rulers.verdict: Asa took the silver and gold left in the treasuries of the house of the LORD and of the palace, and sent them…

rulers.name: Ben-hadad
rulers.title: King of Syria (Aram) in the days of Elisha
rulers.tagline: Besieged Samaria; smothered on his sickbed.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length of reign; it tells how it ended (2 Kings 8:15).
otherNames: Ben-hadad king of Syria (in Elisha's day)
rulers.verdict: “Ben-hadad king of Syria gathered all his host, and went up, and besieged Samaria.”

rulers.name: Hazael
rulers.title: King of Syria (Aram) at Damascus
rulers.tagline: Elisha wept over the evil he would do to Israel.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length of reign; he oppressed Israel “all the days of Jehoahaz” (2 Kings 13:22).

dates.label: From Shalmaneser III's records and Scripture, on the main system's dates

rulers.verdict: At Horeb the LORD told Elijah: “anoint Hazael to be king over Syria”.

rulers.name: Ben-hadad
rulers.title: King of Syria (Aram), son of Hazael
rulers.tagline: Three times beaten by Jehoash of Israel.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length of reign.

dates.label: From Scripture, on the main system's dates

rulers.verdict: The LORD delivered Israel “into the hand of Ben-hadad the son of Hazael, all their days”.

rulers.name: Rezin
rulers.title: King of Syria (Aram) at Damascus
rulers.tagline: With Pekah against Ahaz; slain when Assyria took Damascus.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length of reign; it tells how it ended (2 Kings 16:9).

dates.label: From the Assyrian records: king by about 738 BC

rulers.verdict: “In those days the LORD began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah.”

rulers.name: Tiglath-pileser
rulers.title: King of Assyria
rulers.tagline: The Assyrian king who took Galilee and Gilead, and to whom Ahaz sent the temple's silver.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length for his reign. It places him in the days of Menahem, Pekah and Ahaz.
rulers.verdict: "Pul the king of Assyria came against the land" in Menahem's reign; Menahem gave him a thousand talents of…

rulers.name: Shalmaneser
rulers.title: King of Assyria
rulers.tagline: The king of Assyria who made Hoshea his servant and besieged Samaria.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length for his reign. It places him in the reigns of Hoshea of Israel and Hezekiah of Judah.
rulers.verdict: "Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him presents."

rulers.name: Sargon
rulers.title: King of Assyria
rulers.tagline: Named once in Scripture: the king who sent his Tartan against Ashdod.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length for his reign and dates nothing by it.
rulers.verdict: "In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against…

rulers.name: Sennacherib
rulers.title: King of Assyria
rulers.tagline: The king of Assyria who took Judah's fenced cities and sent his army against Jerusalem, then went home to Nineveh.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length for his reign. It dates his invasion to Hezekiah's fourteenth year.
rulers.verdict: "Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah did Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all the fenced…

rulers.name: Esarhaddon
rulers.title: King of Assyria
rulers.tagline: Sennacherib's son, who reigned after him; settlers he brought into the land dated their worship from his days.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length for his reign; it says only that he reigned in his father's stead.
rulers.verdict: "And Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead."

rulers.name: Merodach-baladan
rulers.title: King of Babylon
rulers.tagline: The king of Babylon whose envoys Hezekiah showed all his treasures.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length for his reign. It sets his embassy "at that time", after Hezekiah's illness.
rulers.verdict: "At that time Berodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present unto…

rulers.name: Nebuchadnezzar
rulers.title: King of Babylon
rulers.tagline: The king of Babylon who took Jerusalem, burned the temple and carried Judah into exile; Daniel's king.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length for his reign. It dates events by his years, from his first to his twenty-third.
rulers.verdict: The LORD calls him "Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant", and says "have I given all these lands…

rulers.name: Evil-merodach
rulers.title: King of Babylon
rulers.tagline: The king of Babylon who brought Jehoiachin out of prison and fed him at his table.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length for his reign. It dates his release of Jehoiachin to the year he began to reign, the 37th of Jehoiachin's captivity.
rulers.verdict: "Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of…

rulers.name: Gedaliah
rulers.title: Governor of Judah under Babylon
rulers.tagline: Governor at Mizpah over the poor of the land; murdered in the seventh month.
rulers.reignText: Not given. He was made governor after Jerusalem fell in Nebuchadnezzar's nineteenth year (2 Kgs 25:8, 22) and was killed "in the seventh month"; Scripture does not say of which year (2 Kgs 25:25; Jer 41:1).
rulers.verdict: He swore to the captains: "Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldees: dwell in the land, and serve the king…
rulers.house: Son of Ahikam, son of Shaphan

rulers.name: Belshazzar
rulers.title: King of Babylon, as Daniel calls him
rulers.tagline: The king at whose feast the writing appeared on the wall; slain the same night.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length for his reign. Daniel dates visions to his first and third years.
rulers.verdict: "Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords", and had the gold and silver vessels from…

rulers.name: Pharaoh of Joseph's day
rulers.title: King of Egypt (not named in Scripture)
rulers.tagline: The king who raised Joseph from the prison to rule Egypt.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length of reign. "Pharaoh" raised Joseph at thirty and was still the title of the king who let Joseph bury Jacob, about twenty-six years later (Gen 41:46; 45:6; 47:28; 50:6).
rulers.verdict: He dreamed of seven fat and seven lean kine, and of full and thin ears, and none of the magicians or wise men…

rulers.name: Pharaoh of the oppression
rulers.title: King of Egypt (not named in Scripture)
rulers.tagline: The "new king" who set taskmasters over Israel and ordered the sons cast into the river.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length. The record runs from the start of the hard bondage, through Moses' birth and flight, to "the king of Egypt died" while Moses was in Midian (Exod 1:8–2:23).
rulers.verdict: "Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph."

rulers.name: Pharaoh of the Exodus
rulers.title: King of Egypt (not named in Scripture)
rulers.tagline: "Who is the LORD, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go?"
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length. Moses was eighty when he and Aaron spoke to him (Exod 7:7).
rulers.verdict: "Who is the LORD, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the LORD, neither will I let…

rulers.name: Pharaoh, Solomon's father-in-law
rulers.title: King of Egypt (not named in Scripture)
rulers.tagline: He gave Solomon his daughter, and Gezer as her dowry.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length. The marriage falls early in Solomon's reign, before his house, the temple and the wall were finished (1 Kgs 3:1).
rulers.verdict: "And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh's daughter, and brought her into the…

rulers.name: Shishak
rulers.title: King of Egypt
rulers.tagline: He sheltered Jeroboam, then plundered Jerusalem in Rehoboam's fifth year.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length. He was already king while Solomon lived (1 Kgs 11:40) and came against Jerusalem in Rehoboam's fifth year (1 Kgs 14:25).

dates.label: Hornung, Krauss and Warburton (2006), for Shoshenq I

rulers.verdict: Jeroboam "fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon".

rulers.name: So
rulers.title: King of Egypt
rulers.tagline: Named once: Hoshea's appeal to him cost Israel its king.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no years; it names him once, in Hoshea's reign over Israel (2 Kgs 17:4).
rulers.verdict: "And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea: for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and…

rulers.name: Tirhakah
rulers.title: King of Ethiopia (Cush)
rulers.tagline: The news of his march made Sennacherib write to Hezekiah.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no years. It names him twice, in one report, as "king of Ethiopia" (2 Kgs 19:9; Isa 37:9).

dates.label: Hornung, Krauss and Warburton (2006), for Taharqa

rulers.verdict: "And when he heard say of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, Behold, he is come out to fight against thee: he sent…

rulers.name: Pharaoh Necho
rulers.title: King of Egypt
rulers.tagline: He killed Josiah at Megiddo, made and unmade Judah's kings, and lost at Carchemish.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no years for him. Herodotus gives him sixteen years.

dates.label: Hornung, Krauss and Warburton (2006), for Necho II

rulers.verdict: "In his days Pharaoh-nechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and…

rulers.name: Hophra
rulers.title: King of Egypt
rulers.tagline: Zedekiah's ally, given "into the hand of his enemies".
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no years for him. Herodotus gives Apries twenty-five years.

dates.label: Hornung, Krauss and Warburton (2006), for Apries

rulers.verdict: "Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give Pharaoh-hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies, and into…

rulers.name: Jeroboam I
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Twenty-two years: the first king of the ten tribes.
rulers.reignText: Twenty-two years (1 Kings 14:20)
prophets: The man of God from Judah

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: Jeroboam returned not from his evil way

rulers.name: Nadab
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Two years, ended by a soldier's coup at Gibbethon.
rulers.reignText: Two years (1 Kings 15:25)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he did evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Baasha
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Twenty-four years in Tirzah, after killing Nadab.
rulers.reignText: Twenty-four years (1 Kings 15:33)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he did evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Elah
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Two years in Tirzah; killed while drinking.
rulers.reignText: Two years (1 Kings 16:8)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Israel to sin

rulers.name: Zimri
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Seven days in Tirzah.
rulers.reignText: Seven days (1 Kings 16:15)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Omri
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Twelve years; the founder of Samaria.
rulers.reignText: Twelve years, six of them in Tirzah (1 Kings 16:23)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the LORD, and did worse than all that were before him

rulers.name: Ahab
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Twenty-two years in Samaria.
rulers.reignText: Twenty-two years in Samaria (1 Kings 16:29)
prophets: One of the sons of the prophets

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD above all that were before him

rulers.name: Ahaziah
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Two years; died of a fall in Samaria.
rulers.reignText: Two years (1 Kings 22:51)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he did evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Joram
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Twelve years; the last king of Omri's house.
rulers.reignText: Twelve years (2 Kings 3:1)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he wrought evil in the sight of the LORD; but not like his father, and like his mother

rulers.name: Jehu
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Twenty-eight years in Samaria, after ending the house of Ahab.
rulers.reignText: Twenty-eight years in Samaria (2 Kings 10:36)
otherNames: Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the LORD God of Israel with all his heart

rulers.name: Jehoahaz
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Seventeen years under Hazael's oppression.
rulers.reignText: Seventeen years (2 Kings 13:1)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Jehoash
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Sixteen years; three victories over Syria and one over Judah.
rulers.reignText: Sixteen years (2 Kings 13:10)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Jeroboam II
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Forty-one years in Samaria; Israel's borders restored.
rulers.reignText: Forty-one years in Samaria (2 Kings 14:23)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Zechariah
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Six months; the last king of Jehu's house.
rulers.reignText: Six months (2 Kings 15:8)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as his fathers had done

rulers.name: Shallum
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: One month in Samaria.
rulers.reignText: “A full month” (2 Kings 15:13)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.name: Menahem
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Ten years in Samaria; tribute to Assyria.
rulers.reignText: Ten years in Samaria (2 Kings 15:17)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Pekahiah
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Two years; killed in his own palace.
rulers.reignText: Two years (2 Kings 15:23)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Pekah
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Twenty years; Assyria takes Galilee and Gilead.
rulers.reignText: Twenty years (2 Kings 15:27)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Hoshea
rulers.title: King of Israel
rulers.tagline: Nine years; the last king of Israel.
rulers.reignText: Nine years (2 Kings 17:1)

dates.label: Thiele, as revised by McFall and Young

rulers.verdict: he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, but not as the kings of Israel that were before him

rulers.name: Rehoboam
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Seventeen years in Jerusalem, as the kingdom split in two.
rulers.reignText: Seventeen years, from the age of forty-one (1 Kgs 14:21; 2 Chr 12:13).
rulers.verdict: And Judah did evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Abijah
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Three years in Jerusalem, at war with Jeroboam.
rulers.reignText: Three years (1 Kgs 15:2; 2 Chr 13:2). His age at accession is not given.
rulers.verdict: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him

rulers.name: Asa
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Forty-one years in Jerusalem.
rulers.reignText: Forty-one years (1 Kgs 15:10); he died in his forty-first year (2 Chr 16:13). His age at accession is not given.
rulers.verdict: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, as did David his father.

rulers.name: Jehoshaphat
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Twenty-five years in Jerusalem, at peace with Ahab's house.
rulers.reignText: Twenty-five years, from the age of thirty-five (1 Kgs 22:42; 2 Chr 20:31).
rulers.verdict: doing that which was right in the eyes of the LORD

rulers.name: Jehoram
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Eight years in Jerusalem, married into Ahab's house.
rulers.reignText: Eight years, from the age of thirty-two (2 Kgs 8:17; 2 Chr 21:5, 20). His mother is not named.
rulers.verdict: and he did evil in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Ahaziah
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: One year in Jerusalem, killed in Jehu's revolt.
rulers.reignText: One year (2 Kgs 8:26; 2 Chr 22:2). His age is twenty-two in Kings and forty-two in Chronicles.
rulers.verdict: and did evil in the sight of the LORD, as did the house of Ahab

rulers.name: Athaliah
rulers.title: Queen who reigned over Judah
rulers.tagline: Six years on David's throne, the only woman to reign over Judah.
rulers.reignText: Six years, while the boy Joash was hidden in the temple (2 Kgs 11:3; 2 Chr 22:12). Scripture gives her no regnal formula: no cross-date, age, verdict, source note or burial.
rulers.verdict: "Athaliah did reign over the land." That one sentence (in Chronicles, "Athaliah reigned over the land") is…

rulers.name: Joash
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Forty years in Jerusalem, crowned at seven.
rulers.reignText: Forty years, from the age of seven (2 Kgs 11:21; 12:1; 2 Chr 24:1).
rulers.verdict: And Jehoash did that which was right in the sight of the LORD all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest…

rulers.name: Amaziah
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Twenty-nine years in Jerusalem; victor over Edom, beaten by Israel.
rulers.reignText: Twenty-nine years, from the age of twenty-five (2 Kgs 14:2; 2 Chr 25:1).
rulers.verdict: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, yet not like David his father

rulers.name: Uzziah
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Fifty-two years in Jerusalem, the last of them as a leper.
rulers.reignText: Fifty-two years, from the age of sixteen (2 Kgs 15:2; 2 Chr 26:3). In his last years his son Jotham judged the people.
rulers.verdict: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah had done

rulers.name: Jotham
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Sixteen years in Jerusalem, after ruling for his leper father.
rulers.reignText: Sixteen years, from the age of twenty-five (2 Kgs 15:33; 2 Chr 27:1, 8). Before that he was "over the house, judging the people" for his father.
rulers.verdict: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Ahaz
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Sixteen years in Jerusalem, Assyria's servant.
rulers.reignText: Sixteen years, from the age of twenty (2 Kgs 16:2; 2 Chr 28:1). His mother is not named.
rulers.verdict: and did not that which was right in the sight of the LORD his God, like David his father

rulers.name: Hezekiah
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Twenty-nine years in Jerusalem; "after him was none like him".
rulers.reignText: Twenty-nine years, from the age of twenty-five (2 Kgs 18:2; 2 Chr 29:1). Fifteen years were added to his life after his illness (2 Kgs 20:6).
rulers.verdict: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father did.

rulers.name: Manasseh
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Fifty-five years in Jerusalem, the longest reign in Judah.
rulers.reignText: Fifty-five years, from the age of twelve (2 Kgs 21:1; 2 Chr 33:1).
rulers.verdict: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, after the abominations of the heathen

rulers.name: Amon
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Two years in Jerusalem, killed in his own house.
rulers.reignText: Two years, from the age of twenty-two (2 Kgs 21:19; 2 Chr 33:21).
rulers.verdict: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as his father Manasseh did.

rulers.name: Josiah
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Thirty-one years in Jerusalem, from the age of eight.
rulers.reignText: Thirty-one years, from the age of eight (2 Kgs 22:1; 2 Chr 34:1).
prophets: The man of God from Judah (unnamed)
rulers.verdict: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD

rulers.name: Jehoahaz
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Three months in Jerusalem, then a prisoner of Egypt.
rulers.reignText: Three months, at the age of twenty-three (2 Kgs 23:31; 2 Chr 36:2).
rulers.verdict: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.

rulers.name: Jehoiakim
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Eleven years in Jerusalem, under Egypt and then Babylon.
rulers.reignText: Eleven years, from the age of twenty-five (2 Kgs 23:36; 2 Chr 36:5).
rulers.verdict: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.

rulers.name: Jehoiachin
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Three months in Jerusalem, thirty-seven years a captive in Babylon.
rulers.reignText: Three months (2 Kgs 24:8), or three months and ten days (2 Chr 36:9). Kings gives his age as eighteen, Chronicles as eight.
rulers.verdict: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father had done.

rulers.name: Zedekiah
rulers.title: King of Judah
rulers.tagline: Eleven years in Jerusalem, the last king of Judah.
rulers.reignText: Eleven years, from the age of twenty-one (2 Kgs 24:18; 2 Chr 36:11; Jer 52:1).
rulers.verdict: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

rulers.name: Hiram
rulers.title: King of Tyre
rulers.tagline: Cedar for David's house and for Solomon's temple.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length of reign; Josephus, quoting Menander, gives thirty-four years.

dates.label: Our own count, from Josephus's Tyrian figures and the main system's date for the temple

rulers.verdict: “Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons: and they built…

rulers.name: The queen of Sheba
rulers.title: Queen of Sheba
rulers.tagline: She came to Solomon with hard questions.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length of reign; her visit fell in Solomon's reign.
otherNames: The queen of the south (Matthew 12:42; Luke 11:31)
rulers.verdict: She heard “of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD”, and came to test him “with hard…

rulers.name: Mesha
rulers.title: King of Moab
rulers.tagline: A sheepmaster who threw off Israel's yoke.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length of reign.
rulers.verdict: “Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, and rendered unto the king of Israel an hundred thousand lambs, and an…

rulers.name: Candace
rulers.title: Queen of the Ethiopians
rulers.tagline: Her treasurer met Philip on the road to Gaza.
rulers.reignText: Scripture gives no length of reign and no date.
rulers.verdict: Philip met “a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had…

rulers.name: Darius the Mede
rulers.title: King over the realm of the Chaldeans (Daniel)
rulers.tagline: Took the kingdom at about sixty-two; known only from Daniel.
rulers.reignText: Not given. Daniel says he took the kingdom "being about threescore and two years old" and dates by his "first year" only (Dan 5:31; 9:1; 11:1).

dates.label: Keil (1872): first year 538 BC, two years before Cyrus reigned alone

apostles.name: Philip the evangelist
apostles.title: “Philip the evangelist, which was one of the seven” (Acts 21:8)
apostles.tagline: Preached in Samaria, baptized an Ethiopian official on the Gaza road, and settled at Caesarea.
apostles.home: When Paul passed through, years after Acts 8, Philip had a house at Caesarea, where Paul's company stayed “many days”.

apostles.name: Barnabas
otherNames: Joses (KJV, Acts 4:36); Joseph in the Revised Version
apostles.title: Called an apostle with Paul (Acts 14:14)
apostles.tagline: The Levite from Cyprus who vouched for Saul, taught with him at Antioch, and went out with him on the first journey.
apostles.home: “A Levite, and of the country of Cyprus” (Acts 4:36); Acts first finds him in the Jerusalem church.
apostles.trade: Scripture gives him no trade. He “having land, sold it” for the common fund (Acts 4:37), and Paul's question “Or I only and Barnabas, have not we power to forbear working?” (1 Corinthians 9:6) speaks of the two of them working for their living.
apostles.ending: Scripture does not record his death. Acts last shows him sailing to Cyprus with Mark (Acts 15:39).

apostles.home: His mother Mary had a house in Jerusalem where “many were gathered together praying” the night Peter was freed from prison.

apostles.tagline: Sent from Jerusalem with the council's letter; Paul's partner in Macedonia.

apostles.name: Timothy
apostles.title: Paul's “own son in the faith” (1 Timothy 1:2)
apostles.tagline: A young disciple who served Paul “as a son with the father”.
apostles.home: Paul found him at Derbe and Lystra: “a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus”, “well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium”.
apostles.ending: In 2 Timothy Paul asks him twice to come quickly; Scripture does not say whether he reached Paul.
apostles.tradition: Eusebius writes: “Timothy, so it is recorded, was the first to receive the episcopate of the parish in Ephesus”.

apostles.name: Priscilla and Aquila
apostles.title: Paul's “helpers in Christ Jesus” (Romans 16:3)
apostles.tagline: A tentmaking couple who sheltered Paul, taught Apollos and kept a church in their house.
apostles.home: Aquila was “a certain Jew … born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:)”.
apostles.trade: Tentmakers: Paul “was of the same craft”, so “he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers”.

apostles.ending: The last we read of them: Paul asks Timothy to greet them (2 Timothy 4:19). Scripture does not record their deaths.
